== Availability ==
* Sold from [[Haldor]] for {{Item link|Coins|120}} after [[The Elder]] has been defeated

== Usage ==
=== Crafting ===
*{{Item link|Frostner|size=40px}}
*{{Item link|Iron Sledge|size=40px}}

A total of 23 Ymir Flesh is needed to craft and upgrade both weapons to quality 4.

== Trivia ==
* In the ''Poetic Edda,'' the body of the primeval being Ymir is used to create the world. Ymir's flesh, in particular, is used to create the earth. Therefore, it is possible that this is a pile of ordinary dirt.
* Prior to Patch 0.213.4, it was for sale only after [[Bonemass]], the third boss, has been defeated.

'''Obsidian''' is black volcanic glass found in the [[Mountain]]. Finding it unlocks the [[Tool Shelf]] upgrade for the [[Workbench]] and two different kinds of elemental [[arrows]].

== Availability ==
[[File:Obsidian deposit.jpg|thumb|left|120px|Obsidian deposit]]
Obsidian occurs in boulder-like deposits on the slopes of [[Mountain]]s. It is more likely to be found on the higher slopes. Obsidian deposits require an [[Iron Pickaxe]] or better to mine. The glass-like deposits shatter when struck and so are best harvested from the low side, to avoid losing any shards.

Alternatively, Obsidian can sometimes be found inside [[loot chest]]s inside [[Frost Caves]], which are also located in Mountain biomes.

Unlike metal and metal ores, Obsidian can be taken through portals.
